scanNote:
2-UNITNING IKKINCHI BETI (13-bet).

⚠ SKAN OGOHLANTIRISHI: bu bet PDF faylida 18-o'rinda turadi - ya'ni 15 va 16-betlardan KEYIN. Skanda betlar tartibi buzilgan.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Night and Day' va ko'k yorliqda oq '2'.

CHAP TOMONDA (to'q ko'k kosmos foni ustida) yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi MAQOLA:
Sarlavha: 'NIGHT AND DAY AROUND THE MILKY WAY'
Kirish (qiya harflar): "Every day aboard a space shuttle is different in many ways, but you're always busy up there!" said crew member Leroy Chiao when we asked him to tell us about a typical day on a mission in orbit.
So'ng uchta ko'k kichik sarlavha va matn: 'Good Morning!', "Let's get busy!", 'Astronauts need to rest, too!'
Matn ichida uchta raqamli KATAKChA (1, 2, 3) - 12-betdagi 5-mashqning bo'shliqlari.
Qalin harfli so'zlar: 'morning' messages, wet sponge, task, razors, projects involving, activities, view, closely, break, personal, admire, take over.
Pastda E surati - kemaning manipulyator qo'li yonida ochiq kosmosda ishlayotgan kosmonavt, orqada Yer.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development' sarlavhasi.
6) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: space, six-hour, take, typical, short, couple, personal, each other, rock, wet. Ikki ustunda 10 ta nuqtali qator.
7) 'Underline the correct word(s) in bold.' Beshta gap, har birida qalin harfli ikki variant.
8) 'Fill in:' crew, audience, fans, viewers. To'rtta gap.
9) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Sakkiz ibora bir xatboshida.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article again and take notes about the astronauts' daily routine under these headings:' - uchta ko'k band: the 'morning'; the 'afternoon'; the 'evening'. So'ng: 'Use your notes to talk about a typical day in the life of an astronaut aboard a space shuttle.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '13'.

exercises.instructionEn: NIGHT AND DAY AROUND THE MILKY WAY
exercises.instructionUz: SOMON YO'LI ATROFIDA KECHA VA KUNDUZ
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar to'ldirilgan
holda).


⚠ MATNNING TUZILIShI:

  Kirish - Leroy Chiao kim va nima
     haqida gapiradi
  'Good Morning!' - uyg'onish, yuvinish,
     nonushta
  "Let's get busy!" - ish, kosmik sayr,
     tushlik
  'Astronauts need to rest, too!' -
     bo'sh vaqt va uyqu

  ⚠ Uchta kichik sarlavha - kunning
  uchta qismi. 13-betdagi Speaking
  mashqi aynan shu bo'linishni so'raydi.


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'MORNING', 'AFTERNOON',
'EVENING' TIRNOQ IChIDA:

  Orbitada kema Yer atrofida 90 daqiqada
  aylanadi - ya'ni bir kunda 16 marta
  quyosh chiqadi va botadi!

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'ertalab' va 'kechqurun'
  ShARTLI: ekipaj Yerdagi soatga
  (CST) qarab yashaydi.

  ⚠ Tirnoq belgisi 'bu haqiqiy ertalab
  emas' degan ma'noni beradi.


⚠ VAQTLAR:

  6:41 pm CST - uyg'onish
  8:45 pm CST - ish boshlanishi
  8:45 am CST - ishning tugashi
  10:41 am CST - uyqu

  ⚠ Ya'ni ekipajning 'kuni' kechqurun
  boshlanadi va ertalab tugaydi -
  Yerdagi vaqt bo'yicha teskari.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  a wet sponge  = ho'l gubka
  a task        = vazifa, topshiriq
  a razor       = ustara
  to involve    = o'z ichiga olmoq
  an activity   = mashg'ulot
  a view        = manzara
  closely       = yaqindan, zich
  a break       = tanaffus
  personal      = shaxsiy
  to admire     = zavqlanib qaramoq
  to take over  = navbatni olmoq

points.en: "Every day aboard a space shuttle is different in many ways, but you're always busy up there!" said crew member Leroy Chiao.
points.uz: "Kosmik kemadagi har kun ko'p jihatdan boshqacha, lekin u yerda doim bandsan!" - dedi ekipaj a'zosi Leroy Chiao.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'aboard' = bort ustida ('on board' ning
qisqa shakli).
⚠ 'in many ways' = ko'p jihatdan.
⚠ 'up there' = u yerda, yuqorida (kosmosda).

points.en: ... when we asked him to tell us about a typical day on a mission in orbit.
points.uz: ... biz undan orbitadagi topshiriqda odatiy kun haqida gapirib berishni so'raganimizda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'ON a mission' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 'IN orbit' - artiklsiz.

points.en: Every 'morning', Mission Control wakes the crew up with music at exactly 6:41pm CST (Central Standard Time - that's the same time that people in Chicago use).
points.uz: Har 'ertalab' Boshqaruv markazi ekipajni aynan CST bo'yicha 18:41 da musiqa bilan uyg'otadi (Markaziy standart vaqt - Chikago aholisi ishlatadigan vaqt).
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to wake sb UP' - 'up' zarrachasi bilan.
To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'wakes the crew up'.
⚠ 'exactly' = aynan, roppa-rosa.

points.en: The pieces of music are always different. For example, they might wake up to a traditional Japanese song one day, and a new American rock song the next!
points.uz: Musiqa asarlari har doim boshqacha. Masalan, bir kuni an'anaviy yapon qo'shig'i bilan, ertasiga yangi amerika rok qo'shig'i bilan uyg'onishlari mumkin!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a piece of music' = musiqa asari.
'music' SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'a piece of' kerak.
⚠ 'might' = ehtimol (5-mashqning javobi).

points.en: After that, they have a couple of hours to wash, have breakfast and get the 'morning' messages from Mission Control.
points.uz: Shundan keyin ularda yuvinish, nonushta qilish va Boshqaruv markazidan 'ertalabki' xabarlarni olish uchun bir-ikki soat bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a couple of' = bir-ikki (aniq ikki emas).
⚠ 'to have time TO DO sth' - infinitiv.

points.en: Washing isn't easy in space, and it's impossible to have a shower, so the crew wash themselves with a wet sponge.
points.uz: Kosmosda yuvinish oson emas va dush qabul qilish imkonsiz, shuning uchun ekipaj o'zini ho'l gubka bilan yuvadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Kosmosda og'irlik yo'q - suv oqmaydi, balki
sharcha bo'lib uchadi.
⚠ 'themselves' - O'ZLIK olmoshi.
⚠ 'a sponge' - 'spanj' deb o'qiladi.

points.en: Shaving is also a difficult task up there, so the men have to use special 'space' razors.
points.uz: U yerda soqol olish ham qiyin vazifa, shuning uchun erkaklar maxsus 'kosmik' ustaralardan foydalanishga majbur.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'shaving' - -ING shakli EGA vazifasida.
⚠ 'a task' = vazifa (7-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'have to' = majbur bo'lmoq (10-unit mavzusi).

points.en: At around 8:45 pm CST, the crew starts work. Most of the time they work on projects involving satellites and the shuttle itself.
points.uz: CST bo'yicha taxminan 20:45 da ekipaj ishni boshlaydi. Ko'p vaqt ular sun'iy yo'ldoshlar va kemaning o'ziga oid loyihalar ustida ishlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work ON a project' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 'involving' = o'z ichiga olgan.
⚠ 'the shuttle ITSELF' = kemaning O'ZI
(ta'kidlash uchun).

points.en: They also take photos of their activities and the view from the shuttle to send home.
points.uz: Ular yana mashg'ulotlarining va kemadan ko'rinadigan manzaraning suratini olib, uyga yuboradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to TAKE photos' - 'to make' EMAS.
⚠ 'a view OF sth' - predlog 'of'.

points.en: Each day there are also two six-hour space walks.
points.uz: Har kuni yana ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'six-hour' - DEFIS bilan, HOUR BIRLIKDA
(sifat vazifasida).
⚠ 'each day' = har kuni ('every day' bilan
bir xil).

points.en: "We have between eight and ten minutes to do each task," says Leroy, "so we have to work very closely and help each other."
points.uz: "Har vazifani bajarish uchun sakkiz-o'n daqiqamiz bor," - deydi Leroy, "shuning uchun juda zich ishlashimiz va bir-birimizga yordam berishimiz kerak."
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'between ... and ...' = ... dan ... gacha.
⚠ 'closely' - RAVISh ('close' + -ly).
⚠ 'each other' = bir-biri (12-betdagi
3b mashqida ham bor).

points.en: The crew take a short break for lunch during the 'afternoon'.
points.uz: Ekipaj 'tushdan keyin' tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to TAKE a break' - 'to do' EMAS.
⚠ 'the crew TAKE' - Britaniyada jamoa oti bilan
fe'l KO'PLIKDA bo'lishi mumkin.

points.en: They need a lot of energy, so they eat a lot of food. According to NASA, the crew's special meals are "tasty and very good for them".
points.uz: Ularga ko'p quvvat kerak, shuning uchun ko'p ovqat yeydi. NASA ma'lumotiga ko'ra, ekipajning maxsus taomlari "mazali va ular uchun juda foydali".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to' (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'good FOR sb' = foydali.
⚠ 'energy' va 'food' - SANALMAYDIGAN otlar,
shuning uchun 'a lot of'.

points.en: After lunch, they go back to work until around 8:45 am CST.
points.uz: Tushlikdan keyin ular CST bo'yicha taxminan 08:45 gacha ishga qaytadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'go back TO work' - predlog 'to' (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'work' bu yerda artiklsiz.

points.en: "Fortunately, it's not all work and no play aboard the space shuttle," says Leroy.
points.uz: "Yaxshiyamki, kosmik kemada faqat ish emas," - deydi Leroy.
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'liq maqol: 'All work and no play makes
Jack a dull boy.' = Faqat ishlab dam olmagan
odam zerikarli bo'lib qoladi.

⚠ 'fortunately' = yaxshiyamki ('fortune' -
omad).

points.en: "In the 'evening' we all have a couple of hours to have dinner and relax. Most of us read and send our personal e-mail in this free time, but we also like to read books or listen to music."
points.uz: "'Kechqurun' hammamizda kechki ovqat qilish va dam olish uchun bir-ikki soat bo'ladi. Ko'pchiligimiz shu bo'sh vaqtda shaxsiy elektron xatlarimizni o'qiymiz va yuboramiz, lekin kitob o'qish yoki musiqa tinglashni ham yoqtiramiz."
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'most of us' - 'of' bilan (olmoshdan oldin).
⚠ 'personal' = shaxsiy (6-mashqda ham bor).

points.en: "Sometimes we sit by the window and admire the Earth and the stars."
points.uz: "Ba'zan deraza yonida o'tirib Yer va yulduzlarga zavq bilan qaraymiz."
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to sit BY the window' - predlog 'by'
(= yonida).
⚠ 'to admire' = zavqlanib qaramoq
(7-mashqda ham bor).

points.en: After that, at exactly 10:41 am CST, it's time for the crew to go to bed, while Mission Control and the shuttle's computers take over for the 'night'.
points.uz: Shundan keyin, CST bo'yicha aynan 10:41 da ekipajning uxlash vaqti keladi, Boshqaruv markazi va kemaning kompyuterlari esa 'tun' uchun navbatni oladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "it's time for sb TO DO sth" - turg'un qolip.
⚠ 'to go TO bed' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'to take over' = navbatni olmoq, ish boshini
qabul qilmoq (7 va 9-mashqlarda ham bor).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu yana COLLOCATION mashqi.


⚠ 'A COUPLE OF HOURS':

  = bir-ikki soat.
  ⚠ 'a couple' aslida 'ikki' degani,
  lekin 'a couple of' aniq son emas -
  'bir nechta' ma'nosida.

  ⚠ 'of' ni TUShIRIB QOLDIRMANG:
  'a couple hours' - AQSh so'zlashuv
  nutqida uchraydi, lekin yozuvda XATO.


⚠ 'TO HELP EACH OTHER':

  = bir-biriga yordam bermoq.
  ⚠ 'each other' - IKKI kishi uchun.
  ⚠ 'one another' - ko'p kishi uchun
  (lekin farq deyarli yo'qolgan).


⚠ 'A ROCK SONG':

  ⚠ 'rock' bu yerda MUSIQA turi.
  Boshqa ma'nolari: tosh, qoya;
  tebranmoq.


⚠ 'PERSONAL' va 'PERSONNEL':

  personal (PER-sonal) = shaxsiy
  personnel (person-NEL) = xodimlar

  ⚠ Imlosi va urg'usi boshqa - juda
  ko'p adashtiriladi.


⚠ 'A WET SPONGE':

  ⚠ 'wet' = ho'l; aksi 'dry' = quruq.
  ⚠ 'a sponge' - 'spanj' deb o'qiladi;
  'g' YuMShOQ (j kabi).

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri so'z(lar)ning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.

  ⚠ Har juftlikdagi ikki so'z o'zbekchaga
  BIR XIL tarjima qilinadi - shuning
  uchun ular ataylab qarshi qo'yilgan.


⚠ 'A PIECE' va 'A PART':

  a piece of music = musiqa ASARI
     (butun bir kuy)
  a part of sth = biror narsaning
     QISMI

  ⚠ 'music' sanalmaydigan, shuning
  uchun 'a PIECE of music'.


⚠ 'WORK' va 'A TASK':

  work = umuman ish (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a task = aniq bitta vazifa
     (SANALADIGAN)

  ⚠ 'a difficult work' - XATO,
  chunki 'work' sanalmaydigan.
  To'g'risi: 'difficult work' yoki
  'a difficult task'.


⚠ 'A PROJECT' va 'A WORK':

  a project = reja asosidagi katta ish
  ⚠ 'works' (ko'plikda) = asarlar
  (adabiy, musiqiy) yoki zavod.


⚠ 'ADMIRE' va 'LOOK':

  to admire = zavq bilan qaramoq
  to look AT = shunchaki qaramoq

  ⚠ 4-bandda 'looking' variantida
  predlog 'AT' yo'q - shuning uchun
  ham grammatik jihatdan XATO
  bo'lardi.


⚠ 'TAKE UP' va 'TAKE OVER':

  take up = boshlamoq (mashg'ulot),
     joy egallamoq
  take over = navbatni/ishni qabul
     qilmoq

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the shuttle's computers
  TAKE OVER for the night'.

items.textEn: 1  Josh plays different ___ of music on his morning radio show.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a piece of music' = musiqa ASARI.
⚠ 'music' SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'a piece of' kerak.

⚠ Matnda: 'The pieces of music are always
different.'

items.textEn: 2  Washing is a difficult ___ up in space.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'work' SANALMAYDIGAN - 'a work' bo'lolmaydi.
⚠ 'a task' SANALADIGAN.

⚠ Matnda: 'Shaving is also a difficult TASK.'

items.textEn: 3  Our department usually works on several different ___ at the same time.
items.uz: Reja asosidagi katta ish qanday ataladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a project' = loyiha.
⚠ 'works' (ko'plikda) = asarlar yoki zavod -
bu yerda mos kelmaydi.

⚠ Matnda: 'they work on PROJECTS involving
satellites'.

items.textEn: 4  Grandpa spends hours ___ the view from his bedroom window.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to admire sth' - predlogsiz.
⚠ 'to look AT sth' - predlog ShART, bu yerda
'at' yo'q.

⚠ Matnda: 'we sit by the window and ADMIRE the
Earth'.

items.textEn: 5  We work during the day, then the night staff ___ for the night.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'take over' = navbatni/ishni qabul qilmoq.
⚠ 'take up' = boshlamoq, joy egallamoq.

⚠ Matnda: "the shuttle's computers TAKE OVER
for the 'night'."

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: crew, audience, fans, viewers.
exercises.explanationUz:
ODAMLAR GURUHINING NOMLARI.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada hammasi 'tomoshabinlar'
  yoki 'guruh' bo'lishi mumkin, lekin
  inglizchada HAR BIRI O'Z joyida
  ishlatiladi.


FARQLARI:

  a crew = kema/samolyot/kosmik kema
     XODIMLARI (ekipaj)

  an audience = teatr, konsert,
     ma'ruzadagi TINGLOVChILAR
     (bir joyda o'tirgan)

  fans = MUXLISLAR (sportchi, xonanda,
     jamoaning)

  viewers = TELEKO'RUVChILAR
     (uyda televizor ko'radiganlar)

  ⚠ 'a viewer' - 'to view' (ko'rmoq)
  fe'lidan.
  ⚠ 'a fan' - 'fanatic' so'zining qisqa
  shakli.


⚠ QAYSI FE'L QAYSI GURUH BILAN:

  crew    - welcomes passengers
  fans    - shout, cheer
  audience - claps, applauds
  viewers - watch

  ⚠ 2-bandda 'shouting' (baqirish) -
  bu STADIONDA bo'ladi, demak 'fans'.
  ⚠ 3-bandda 'clapped' (qarsak) va
  'the play' (spektakl) - demak
  'audience'.


⚠ JAMOA OTLARI - FE'L BIRLIKDAMI
YOKI KO'PLIKDA:

  Britaniyada IKKALASI ham mumkin:
     'The crew IS ready.' (bir butun)
     'The crew ARE ready.' (alohida
        odamlar)

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the crew WASH themselves'
  va 'The crew TAKE a short break' -
  KO'PLIKDA.

  ⚠ 'fans' va 'viewers' esa oddiy
  ko'plik otlar - har doim ko'plikda.

items.sentence: The ___ of the ship welcomed the passengers aboard.
items.uz: Kema ekipaji yo'lovchilarni bortda kutib oldi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a crew' = kema/samolyot xodimlari.
⚠ 'aboard' = bort ustida - maqolada ham bor.

items.sentence: The ___ started shouting when Manchester United scored a goal.
items.uz: Manchester Yunayted gol urganda muxlislar baqira boshladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Futbol + baqirish = MUXLISLAR.
⚠ 'to score a goal' = gol urmoq.

⚠ 'a fan' - 'fanatic' so'zining qisqasi.

items.sentence: The ___ clapped loudly when the play ended.
items.uz: Spektakl tugaganda tomoshabinlar qattiq qarsak chaldi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Teatr + qarsak = TINGLOVChILAR (audience).
⚠ 'a play' = spektakl.
⚠ 'to clap' = qarsak chalmoq.

items.sentence: Baywatch is a TV series watched by millions of ___ around the world.
items.uz: Baywatch - dunyo bo'ylab millionlab teleko'ruvchi tomonidan ko'riladigan teleserial.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Televizor = TELEKO'RUVChILAR (viewers).
⚠ 'watched by' - MAJHUL NISBAT.
⚠ 'millions OF' - predlog 'of' ShART.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLI IBORALAR - HAMMASI
MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Predlogni MANTIQ bilan topib
  bo'lmaydi - ular ibora bilan BIRGA
  yodlanadi.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  IN orbit = orbitada
     ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ turg'un ibora.

  ON a mission = topshiriqda
     ⚠ 'on a trip', 'on a journey' kabi.

  wake sb UP = uyg'otmoq
     ⚠ 'up' - predlog emas, ZARRAChA.
     To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi
     mumkin: 'wake me up'.

  work ON projects = loyiha ustida
     ishlamoq

  go back TO work = ishga qaytmoq
     ⚠ 'work' artiklsiz.

  sit BY the window = deraza yonida
     o'tirmoq
     ⚠ 'by' = yonida, yaqinida.
     ⚠ 'at the window' ham mumkin.

  according TO NASA = NASA ma'lumotiga
     ko'ra
     ⚠ 'according to ME' - XATO!
     O'z fikringiz uchun 'in my opinion'
     deyiladi.

  take over FOR the night = tun uchun
     navbatni olmoq


⚠ 'WAKE UP' - IKKI XIL:

  o'timsiz: 'I wake up at seven.'
     (o'zim uyg'onaman)
  o'timli: 'She wakes me up.'
     (meni uyg'otadi)

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'IN orbit' - ARTIKLSIZ turg'un ibora.
⚠ Matnda: 'a typical day on a mission in orbit'.

⚠ 'ON a mission' - 'on a trip', 'on a journey'
kabi.

⚠ 'up' - ZARRAChA, predlog emas.
⚠ To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'wakes the crew up'.

⚠ 'to work ON sth' = biror ish ustida ishlamoq.
⚠ 'to work FOR a company' = kompaniyada
ishlamoq - boshqa predlog!

⚠ 'go back TO' - harakat yo'nalishi.
⚠ 'work' bu yerda ARTIKLSIZ.

⚠ 'by' = yonida, yaqinida.
⚠ 'at the window' ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Matnda: 'we sit BY the window'.

⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to'.

⚠ DIQQAT: 'according to me' - XATO!
O'z fikringiz uchun 'in my opinion'.

⚠ 'for' - qancha vaqtga.

⚠ Matnda: "the shuttle's computers take over
FOR the 'night'."

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and take notes about the astronauts' daily routine under these headings: the 'morning'; the 'afternoon'; the 'evening'. Use your notes to talk about a typical day in the life of an astronaut aboard a space shuttle.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani qayta o'qing va kosmonavtlarning kundalik tartibi haqida shu sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling: 'ertalab'; 'tushdan keyin'; 'kechqurun'. Qaydlaringizdan foydalanib, kosmik kemadagi kosmonavtning odatiy kuni haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLIB GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Uchta sarlavha - maqoladagi uchta
  kichik sarlavhaga aynan mos keladi:
     'Good Morning!' → the 'morning'
     "Let's get busy!" → the 'afternoon'
     'Astronauts need to rest, too!' →
        the 'evening'

  ✗ 'Mission Control wakes the crew up

  shuncha ERKIN bo'lasiz - yodlab

  Kundalik tartib - ODAT, shuning uchun
  PRESENT SIMPLE:

  ⚠ Ketma-ketlik so'zlari yordam beradi:

⚠ NIMA UChUN TIRNOQ IChIDA:

points.en: the 'morning': 6:41 pm CST - wake up with music; a couple of hours to wash (wet sponge, special razors), have breakfast, get messages from Mission Control
points.uz: 'ertalab': CST 18:41 - musiqa bilan uyg'onish; yuvinish (ho'l gubka, maxsus ustara), nonushta, Boshqaruv markazidan xabarlar olish uchun bir-ikki soat
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning 'Good Morning!' qismidan.

⚠ Gapirganda: 'The crew wakeS up at 6:41 pm.'
- PRESENT SIMPLE, 3-shaxs -S.

points.en: the 'afternoon': 8:45 pm CST - start work; projects with satellites, take photos, two six-hour space walks, work closely and help each other; a short break for lunch; back to work until 8:45 am
points.uz: 'tushdan keyin': CST 20:45 - ish boshlanadi; sun'iy yo'ldosh loyihalari, surat olish, ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr, zich ishlash va bir-biriga yordam; tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus; 08:45 gacha yana ish
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning "Let's get busy!" qismidan.

⚠ 'to TAKE photos', 'to TAKE a break' -
ikkalasi ham 'take' bilan.

points.en: the 'evening': a couple of hours for dinner and relaxing; read and send personal e-mail, read books, listen to music, sit by the window and admire the Earth; 10:41 am CST - go to bed
points.uz: 'kechqurun': kechki ovqat va dam olish uchun bir-ikki soat; shaxsiy elektron xat o'qish va yuborish, kitob o'qish, musiqa tinglash, deraza yonida o'tirib Yerga zavq bilan qarash; CST 10:41 - uxlash
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning 'Astronauts need to rest, too!'
qismidan.

⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

points.en: A typical day: First, the crew wake up at 6:41 pm CST. Then they wash and have breakfast. After that, they start work at 8:45 pm. Finally, they go to bed at 10:41 am.
points.uz: Odatiy kun: Avval ekipaj CST bo'yicha 18:41 da uyg'onadi. Keyin yuvinadi va nonushta qiladi. Shundan keyin 20:45 da ishni boshlaydi. Nihoyat, 10:41 da uxlagani yotadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI: First, Then,
After that, Finally.

⚠ Ular gapni bog'laydi va nutqni tushunarli
qiladi - bu 4-unitning mavzusi ham.

patterns.exampleEn: First, the crew wake up. Then they have breakfast. After that, they start work. Finally, they go to bed.
patterns.exampleUz: Avval ekipaj uyg'onadi. Keyin nonushta qiladi. Shundan keyin ishni boshlaydi. Nihoyat, uxlagani yotadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ KETMA-KETLIK so'zlari - kundalik tartibni
so'zlashning asosi.
⚠ Har biridan keyin VERGUL.

patterns.formula: They have a couple of hours to [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: They have a couple of hours to wash and have breakfast.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda yuvinish va nonushta qilish uchun bir-ikki soat bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a couple OF' - 'of' ShART.
⚠ 'time TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: According to NASA, the meals are tasty.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to'.
⚠ 'according to me' - XATO! 'In my opinion'
deyiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: It's time for the crew to go to bed.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Turg'un qolip: 'it's time for sb to do sth'.
⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

groups.explanationUz: Fe'l + zarracha butunlay yangi ma'no beradi. 9-mashqdagi iboralar.
